source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: During the opposing turn, The Yncarne can use **[Inevitable Death](vsdata:ability/aeldari.the-yncarne.inevitable-death)** once, provided it is already in play and a different friendly **AELDARI** unit dies. Lift The Yncarne and return it at the nearest position to the other unit’s last model that keeps it clear of enemy [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range). The relocation leaves its movement eligibility intact.
